outcome: Offspring's cord blood Homeostasis Model Assessment 2-Insulin Resistance (HOMA-IR)
cohort: The study included 91 mother-infant pairs (n = 182) of white Caucasian origin living in the UK.
finding: Low maternal vitamin B12 status was independently associated with lower cord blood HDL-cholesterol and higher cord blood homocysteine in white Caucasian offspring.
cross-section timing: at birth (maternal blood at delivery and newborn cord blood)
